adjudication.rationale: Looking at the handleCancelBooking.ts diff around lines 415-470, the code now iterates over bookingCalendarReference (an array) with `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside the recurring event handling block (lines 430-450), it still uses `bookingToDelete.user.credentials` and iterates through `updatedBookings`, finding `bookingRef` with `.find()` which returns only the first calendar reference. This means for each reference in the outer loop, the inner recurring event logic processes the same first bookingRef repeatedly, potentially causing duplicate deletion requests for the first reference while missing secondary-host calendar events.
